description: This PHP source file defines a helper class 'JobStatusHelper' used for managing and constructing job status and job name information related to calendar synchronization operations within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods to generate condition strings for job filtering and to create standardized job names based on calendar account, location, and event data.

classes.name: JobStatusHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing job statuses and constructing job-related information, specifically for calendar synchronization tasks.

methods.name: getActiveJobStatusCondition
methods.description: Returns a condition string to filter active jobs in the job queue based on the 'done' status and deletion flag.

methods.name: getMeetingJobCondition
methods.description: Constructs a condition string to identify a specific meeting synchronization job based on job name and target.

methods.name: generateAccountJobName
methods.description: Creates a standardized job name string for a calendar account synchronization process.

methods.name: generateMeetingJobName
methods.description: Creates a detailed and formatted job name string for a calendar sync meeting operation, including account, location, and event identifiers.
